reference_cohort_info_part.note: This study uses CentileBrain (Ge et al., 2024), a pre-trained normative modeling tool trained on 37,407 healthy comparison brains primarily from the ENIGMA Consortium (87 datasets). The normative model was not built within this paper. Therefore, RCI-1 through RCI-7 extraction is not applicable.
reference_cohort_info_part.supporting_text: "Individual regional volumetric z-scores were generated using CentileBrain (Ge et al., 2024), an open source online software tool that leverages an aggregated neuroimaging dataset with a large number of individuals (37,407 comparison brains)."
